Subject: Connect your mailbox to ohmail

ohmail.

Connect your mailbox.

You started an ohmail trial, and no mailbox is connected yet. So ohmail has no mail to organize for you.

Gmail takes an app password, not your Google password. Turn on 2-Step Verification in your Google account, create an app password with any name and paste its 16 letters into the mailbox step.

The button below opens the mailbox step, through sign-in if needed. Connecting takes a few minutes.

Connect your mailbox:
https://app.ohmail.app/login?next=join

We send this reminder once. If you have questions or are stuck, reply to this mail and a person answers.
